historical_source_accounting.scope: Earlier baseline predates optimizer and parallel qualification changes plus concurrent unrelated producer edits. Original failed source checks remain failed; this accounting neither certifies their final source nor qualifies the excluded changes.

native_before_after_source_changes.scope: Final same-source binding check only; successful native audits and exact-result parity are separate requirements for a matched timing comparison.

prepared_package_manifest_scope: superproject Python blobs plus explicit scoped changes; Git-linked contents are not expanded and must not be inferred to be deleted
scope_limit: Native evidence belongs to the captured workspace producer. Scoped publication excludes concurrent edits; differences are explicit and are not retroactively qualified. A post-run native audit failure remains a failure; this publication mapping cannot waive it.
